args.title: Fix Export button staying greyed out after failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button stays greyed out after a failed export because the busy state is not reset to false when the export fails. The proposed change is to catch errors in the exportReport promise chain and reset the busy state to false, allowing the button to be clickable again after a failure. Additionally, show an error toast to inform the user that the export failed.
